text.comms.preview_body: Sample message for the top comms area, used to check wrapping and box height
text.comms.preview_line1: PilotA <sample message in the top comms area>
text.comms.preview_line2: Wingman <opening vanilla chat with T does not affect this>
config.acechat.names.clear.tooltip: Clear list: remove every entry and restore default name colors.
config.acechat.names.online_hint: Online players (click to add to the list; already listed ones get selected)
config.acechat.names.online_empty: No online players right now (open a world or server first)
config.acechat.names.list_hint: List entries (click to select and edit)
config.acechat.names.tab.tooltip: Click to add this player to the name color list; if already listed, that entry gets selected for editing.
config.acechat.navigation.back.tooltip: Back: save current changes and close the configuration screen.
config.acechat.navigation.save.tooltip: Save and close: write all changes to config/acechat/client.json.
config.acechat.tab.chat.tooltip: Chat box: background color, size, position and how long each message stays.
config.acechat.tab.portrait.tooltip: Portrait HUD: panel size and position, portrait tint/opacity/brightness, panel and border style.
config.acechat.tab.preview.tooltip: Preview & drag: live preview; drag the portrait or the chat box to move them, drag the corner handle to resize.
config.acechat.tab.names.tooltip: Player name colors: give specific players a custom name color in chat.
config.acechat.tab.elements.tooltip: Text elements: add, remove and edit the text lines drawn inside the portrait.
config.acechat.tab.data.tooltip: Import/Export: dump the whole configuration to JSON or import it from the clipboard.
config.acechat.tab.reset.tooltip: Reset: restore default text elements or the whole configuration.
config.acechat.chat.enabled.tooltip: Comms HUD: whether the top player chat is shown. Range ON/OFF, default ON.
config.acechat.chat.width.tooltip: Chat box width: width of the top background panel. Range 120~900 px, default 300.
config.acechat.chat.max_lines.tooltip: Max lines: how many chat lines are kept at once. Range 1~12, default 5.
config.acechat.chat.x.tooltip: Horizontal position: move the chat box left/right from screen center. Range -400~400 px, default 0.
config.acechat.chat.y.tooltip: Distance from top: how far the chat box sits from the top edge. Range 0~400 px, default 24.
config.acechat.chat.alpha.tooltip: Background opacity: lower makes the chat background more transparent. Range 0%~100%, default 62%.
config.acechat.chat.name_color.tooltip: Player name color: the default color of player names in the top chat (players with their own color in the list keep theirs). Default blue #4C9AFF.
config.acechat.chat.background.tooltip: Background color: the rectangular backdrop behind chat messages. Default dark blue-grey #1C2838.
config.acechat.chat.padding_x.tooltip: Horizontal padding: gap between text and the left/right edges. Range 0~8 px, default 8.
config.acechat.chat.padding_y.tooltip: Vertical padding: gap between text and the top/bottom edges. Range 0~8 px, default 5.
config.acechat.chat.border.tooltip: Chat border: draw a separate colored border. Range ON/OFF, default OFF.
config.acechat.chat.border_color.tooltip: Border color: color and alpha of the chat border. Default green #FF63E66B.
config.acechat.chat.border_thickness.too: Border thickness: thickness of the chat border. Range 0~2 px, default 1.
config.acechat.chat.hold.tooltip: Message lifetime: how long a message may stay in the top chat area (this also bounds the ones queued behind it). Range 1~60 s, default 6.
config.acechat.chat.hold_min.tooltip: Min dwell time: when someone else speaks, the previous player's message and portrait stay at least this long before switching. Set 0 to switch immediately without waiting. Range 0~5 s, default 1.
config.acechat.chat.hold_max.tooltip: Max dwell time: the dwell time grows with the length of the previous player's message, up to this cap. Range 1~15 s, default 6.
config.acechat.chat.blip.tooltip: New-message sound: plays when a new chat message arrives (configured separately from the message-gone sound). Range ON/OFF, default ON.
config.acechat.chat.volume.tooltip: Sound volume: multiplier on top of the game master volume. Range 0%~100%, default 55%.
config.acechat.portrait.reload_skin.tool: Reload skin: use it after you changed your skin or right after CustomSkinLoader finished loading. Normally not needed - skins are read only on world join, player join, incoming message and when this screen opens; drawing never looks them up, so the cost is negligible.
config.acechat.portrait.enabled.tooltip: Show portrait: whether the portrait panel is drawn; with nobody talking it shows your own bust. Range ON/OFF, default ON.
config.acechat.portrait.width.tooltip: Panel width: width of the portrait panel. Range 80~300 px, default 122.
config.acechat.portrait.height.tooltip: Panel height: height of the portrait panel. Range 90~340 px, default 138.
config.acechat.portrait.scale.tooltip: Overall scale: scale the whole panel. Range 0.5~2.0x, default 1.0.
config.acechat.portrait.ratio_x.tooltip: Horizontal position: panel position across the remaining screen space. Range 0%~100%, default 98% (right).
config.acechat.portrait.ratio_y.tooltip: Vertical position: panel position down the remaining screen space. Range 0%~100%, default 8% (top).
config.acechat.portrait.offset_x.tooltip: Horizontal nudge: extra pixel offset applied after ratio positioning. Range -300~300 px, default 0.
config.acechat.portrait.offset_y.tooltip: Vertical nudge: extra pixel offset applied after ratio positioning. Range -300~300 px, default 0.
config.acechat.portrait.opacity.tooltip: Opacity: lower makes the whole portrait (including text) transparent. Range 0%~100%, default 100%.
config.acechat.portrait.brightness.toolt: Brightness: affects only the portrait texture; 100% is the original color, lower is darker. Range 30%~100%, default 100%.
config.acechat.portrait.tint.tooltip: Tint: multiplies the portrait texture with a color. Default white (no tint).
config.acechat.portrait.panel_color.tool: Panel color: backdrop color of the portrait panel. Default dark blue-grey #1C2838.
config.acechat.portrait.panel_alpha.tool: Panel opacity: lower makes the panel backdrop more transparent. Range 0%~100%, default 92%.
config.acechat.portrait.backdrop.tooltip: Bust backdrop: the plate behind the bust; turn it off and only the character remains (panel color stays). Range ON/OFF, default ON.
config.acechat.portrait.backdrop_color.t: Backdrop color: color of the plate behind the bust. Default near-black blue #0B1016.
config.acechat.portrait.backdrop_alpha.t: Backdrop opacity: lower makes the plate more transparent. Range 0%~100%, default 85%.
config.acechat.portrait.backdrop_padding: Backdrop inset: margin between the plate and the panel edge; also sets the space available to the bust. Range 0~16 px, default 5.
config.acechat.portrait.bust_scale.toolt: Character size: size of the character inside the photo box. Range 40%~150%, default 100%. Lower it to make the photo backdrop more visible.
config.acechat.portrait.photo_mode.toolt: Photo content: what the photo box shows - click to cycle. Full body = the whole character (head, torso, arms, legs) with the second layer composited; Head + shoulders; Bust; Head; Full texture = the raw skin image (all layer patches visible, not composited onto a body).
config.acechat.portrait.outer_layer.tool: Second skin layer master switch: controls the hat, jacket, sleeves and pants overlay areas (the old separate hat toggle is folded into this one). Turn it off to see the difference. Range ON/OFF, default ON.
config.acechat.photo.head: Head (layered)
config.acechat.portrait.photo_height.too: Photo box height: share of the card's inner height used by the photo; the rest is the text block. Range 30%~90%, default 60%.
config.acechat.portrait.photo_divider.to: Photo divider: the thin line between the photo box and the text block (uses the border color). Range ON/OFF, default ON.
config.acechat.portrait.border_color.too: Border color: color and alpha of the panel border. Default green #FF63E66B.
config.acechat.portrait.border_thickness: Border thickness: thickness of the panel border. Range 0~2 px, default 1.
config.acechat.portrait.follow_chat.tool: Hide with chat: only show the portrait while the top chat has messages. Range ON/OFF, default OFF.
config.acechat.portrait.always_visible.t: Keep portrait always: when ON the portrait stays visible even without chat (shows your own portrait). When OFF it follows chat - a player's portrait appears when they speak and disappears once their last message fades. Range ON/OFF, default OFF.
config.acechat.content.name: Player name
config.acechat.content.name.tooltip: Content preset: show the speaking player's name only.
config.acechat.content.vitals.tooltip: Content preset: show health current/max and hunger current.
config.acechat.content.custom.tooltip: Content preset: whatever you type below is shown as-is. Placeholders: %player_name% player name, %player_uuid% player UUID, %health% current health, %max_health% max health, %food% current hunger (food level), %max_food% max hunger (20 in vanilla), %armor% armor, %ping% ping (ms), %dimension% dimension, %world_time% day/night. Unknown placeholders are shown as-is.
config.acechat.preview.hint: This box is the real HUD: drag the portrait to move it, drag its bottom-right handle to resize; drag the chat box to move it, drag its right edge to change width.
config.acechat.preview.drag_hint: Drag a part here to change its position/size
config.acechat.names.add.tooltip: Add a player name color entry.
config.acechat.names.player.tooltip: Player name: matched against chat names. Range any text, default empty.
config.acechat.names.uuid.tooltip: Player UUID: matched first, exactly. Range UUID or empty, default empty.
config.acechat.names.color.tooltip: Name color: only recolors this player's name in chat, alpha included. Default white.
config.acechat.names.note.tooltip: Note: free text remark for this entry. Default empty.
config.acechat.elements.add.tooltip: Add a text element to the portrait.
config.acechat.elements.reset.tooltip: Restore the default name + health elements.
config.acechat.elements.content.tooltip: Content: placeholders - %player_name% player name, %player_uuid% player UUID, %health% current health, %max_health% max health, %food% current hunger (food level), %max_food% max hunger (20 in vanilla), %armor% armor, %ping% ping (ms), %dimension% dimension, %world_time% day/night; unknown placeholders and other text are shown as-is.
config.acechat.elements.horizontal.toolt: Horizontal align: left/center/right inside the portrait area. Click to cycle.
config.acechat.elements.vertical.tooltip: Vertical align: top/center/bottom inside the portrait area. Click to cycle.
config.acechat.elements.shadow.tooltip: Text shadow: draw the vanilla drop shadow. Range ON/OFF, default ON.
config.acechat.elements.x.tooltip: X offset: horizontal nudge after alignment. Range -300~300 px, default 0.
config.acechat.elements.y.tooltip: Y offset: vertical nudge after alignment. Range -300~300 px, default -4.
config.acechat.elements.size.tooltip: Font size: size of this line, 9 is the vanilla size. Range 6~24, default 9.
config.acechat.elements.max_width.toolti: Max width: truncate with an ellipsis beyond this. Range 20~400 px, default 120.
config.acechat.elements.color.tooltip: Text color: color and alpha of this line. Default white.
config.acechat.data.hint: Export writes config/acechat/export/client-export.json; importing backs up the old client.json first and never crashes on bad input.
config.acechat.data.export.tooltip: Export the whole configuration to config/acechat/export/client-export.json.
config.acechat.data.copy.tooltip: Copy the whole configuration JSON to the system clipboard.
config.acechat.data.import_clipboard.too: Read the configuration JSON from the clipboard and import it (backs up first).
config.acechat.data.import_json: Paste JSON and leave the box to import
config.acechat.data.import_json.tooltip: Paste JSON: client.json is backed up first, invalid fields fall back to defaults and never crash.
config.acechat.reset.hint: Resetting overwrites current settings - export a backup in Import/Export first.
config.acechat.reset.elements.tooltip: Restore the default name + health text elements.
config.acechat.reset.all.tooltip: Restore the whole client configuration to defaults (colors, position, size and text elements).
config.acechat.tab.filters.tooltip: Filter presets: overlay filters for the portrait (scanlines / grain / vignette / duotone / dots, or your own PNG) plus color grading (brightness / contrast / saturation / hue / duotone). Save them as presets and re-apply anytime.
screen.acechat.filters.overlay: Overlay filter (covers the whole portrait card)
screen.acechat.filters.grade: Color grading (baked into the skin, zero per-frame cost)
screen.acechat.filters.templates: Presets (click to apply; name goes in the box below)
screen.acechat.filters.empty: No presets yet - tune the settings and press Save as preset
config.acechat.filter.enabled.tooltip: Enable overlay filter: draws the selected filter layer over the WHOLE portrait card (frame, photo and text), for interference lines / grain / vignette looks. Range ON/OFF, default OFF.
config.acechat.filter.alpha.tooltip: Filter strength: opacity of the overlay layer. Range 0%~100%, default 65%.
config.acechat.filter.blend.tooltip: Blend mode: Normal = plain overlay; Multiply = darken only (good for scanlines/vignette); Screen = lighten only; Add = glow. Default Multiply.
config.acechat.filter.rescan.tooltip: Rescan filter folder: drop PNG files into this folder, then click once to pick them up. Folder: %s
config.acechat.filter.template_name.tool: Preset name: name for the current filter settings; press Save as preset to store it (same name overwrites).
config.acechat.filter.save.tooltip: Save as preset: store the current overlay filter + grading settings as a reusable preset.
config.acechat.filter.delete.tooltip: Delete that preset: removes the preset matching the name in the box.
config.acechat.filter.template.tooltip: Click to apply this preset to the portrait.
config.acechat.grade.enabled.tooltip: Enable color grading: recolors the skin texture with the settings below and bakes it into a cached texture (baked once, zero per-frame cost afterwards). Range ON/OFF, default OFF.
config.acechat.grade.brightness.tooltip: Grade brightness: brightness multiplier used while baking. Range 30%~180%, default 100%.
config.acechat.grade.contrast.tooltip: Contrast: scales around mid grey; higher looks punchier. Range 30%~200%, default 100%.
config.acechat.grade.hue.tooltip: Hue shift: rotates all hues. Range -180 to 180 degrees, default 0. Range -180~180.
config.acechat.grade.duotone.tooltip: Duotone: maps luminance onto a dark-to-light two-color gradient (dossier / cinematic look). Range ON/OFF, default OFF.
config.acechat.grade.dark.tooltip: Duotone shadow color: darkest areas map to this color. Default dark blue grey #14202B.
config.acechat.grade.light.tooltip: Duotone highlight color: brightest areas map to this color. Default green #63E66B.
config.acechat.grade.amount.tooltip: Duotone amount: blend ratio of the two-color mapping. Range 0%~100%, default 70%.
screen.acechat.reset.section.tooltip: Reset whole section: restores every page of this section. (Each section now shows two buttons: on page 1 both Reset whole section and Reset this page, on later pages only Reset this page.)
screen.acechat.elements.name_section: Player name (fixed: show / scale / position only)
screen.acechat.elements.custom_section: Custom text elements (add, duplicate, delete, edit content freely)
config.acechat.elements.show.tooltip: Visible: turn it off to hide this line; position and scale settings are kept.
config.acechat.chat.right_gap.tooltip: Gap to portrait: minimum distance kept between the chat box's right edge and the portrait frame; the box shrinks/shifts left to make room. Range 0~240 px, default 12.
config.acechat.chat.left_margin.tooltip: Side margin: minimum distance between the chat box and the screen edges. Range 0~240 px, default 8.
config.acechat.chat.name_max_width.toolt: Max name width: how much room the player name may take in the chat; longer names are truncated with an ellipsis. The body follows right after, and wraps onto more lines when the two limits cannot fit it. Range 20~400 px, default 120.
config.acechat.chat.gone_sound.tooltip: Message-gone sound: plays when a chat message leaves the screen (configured separately from the new-message sound). Range ON/OFF, default ON.
config.acechat.chat.test_sound.tooltip: Preview: plays the new-message sound, then the message-gone sound (custom files take priority).
screen.acechat.chat.sound_dir: Sound folder: %s (use the Open sound folder button)
config.acechat.portrait.mode.tooltip: Skin / artwork switch: Skin = build the character from the player's own skin; Artwork = use a custom PNG image. Drop PNG files (png only) into this folder, then press Rescan: %s
config.acechat.portrait.image_scale.tool: Artwork scale: display size of the custom artwork. Range 10%~400%, default 100%.
config.acechat.portrait.image_offset_x.t: Artwork X offset: horizontal nudge. Range -200~200 px, default 0.
config.acechat.portrait.image_offset_y.t: Artwork Y offset: vertical nudge. Range -200~200 px, default 0.
screen.acechat.portrait.image_hint: Artwork files (PNG only, click to select)
screen.acechat.portrait.image_empty: No artwork yet: drop PNG files into the folder above, then press Rescan
config.acechat.portrait.rescan.tooltip: Rescan artwork folder: after adding PNG files, press once to pick them up in the list below.
screen.acechat.portrait.image_status: Artwork folder: %s (use the Open artwork folder button)
config.acechat.sound.new_volume.tooltip: Appear volume: volume of the new-message sound only (multiplied by the master volume below). Range 0%~200%, default 100%.
config.acechat.sound.new_pitch.tooltip: Appear pitch: changes pitch only, WITHOUT changing playback speed or duration (granular pitch shift). Range 50%~200%, default 100%.
config.acechat.sound.new_fade_in.tooltip: Appear fade-in: time to ramp up at the start. Range 0~200 ms, default 0.
config.acechat.sound.new_fade_out.toolti: Appear fade-out: time to fade away at the end (radio feel). Range 0~400 ms, default 120.
config.acechat.sound.gone_volume.tooltip: Gone volume: volume of the message-gone sound only. Range 0%~200%, default 100%.
config.acechat.sound.gone_pitch.tooltip: Gone pitch: changes pitch only, WITHOUT changing playback speed or duration (granular pitch shift). Range 50%~200%, default 100%.
config.acechat.sound.gone_fade_in.toolti: Gone fade-in: time to ramp up at the start. Range 0~200 ms, default 0.
config.acechat.sound.gone_fade_out.toolt: Gone fade-out: time to fade away at the end. Range 0~400 ms, default 200.
config.acechat.chat.open_sound_dir.toolt: Opens config/acechat/sounds/ in the system file manager; drop new_message.mp3/wav and message_gone.mp3/wav there to replace the sounds.
config.acechat.portrait.open_dir.tooltip: Opens config/acechat/portraits/ in the system file manager; drop PNG files there, then press Rescan.
screen.acechat.portrait.image_hint2: Artwork supports PNG only; falls back to the skin when missing or unreadable
screen.acechat.open_dir.failed: Could not open the folder (open config/acechat/ manually)
config.acechat.sound.new_speed.tooltip: Appear speed: changes playback speed only (also changes duration), independent of pitch. Range 25%~400%, default 100%.
config.acechat.sound.gone_speed.tooltip: Gone speed: changes playback speed only (also changes duration), independent of pitch. Range 25%~400%, default 100%.
screen.acechat.reset.section_all.tooltip: Reset whole section: restores every option on ALL pages of this section (shown on the first page only).
screen.acechat.reset.page.tooltip: Reset this page: restores only the options shown on the CURRENT page; other pages are untouched.
screen.acechat.reset.page_done: This page was reset (%s options; a few text boxes may need manual edits)
screen.acechat.reset.all.tooltip: Reset everything: restores EVERY section and page (chat box through filter templates, including player name colours and the saved template list). Use with care.
config.acechat.chat.vanilla_player.toolt: Show player chat bottom-left: when off, player chat only appears in the top HUD and never lingers in the vanilla spot (multiplayer included). Range ON/OFF, default OFF.
config.acechat.chat.vanilla_other.toolti: Show other messages bottom-left: system messages, command feedback, advancements etc. Independent from the player-chat switch. Range ON/OFF, default ON.
config.acechat.chat.symbol_padding.toolt: Bracket inner gap: space between '<' and the left edge of the content, and between the right edge and '>' (both sides together). Range 0~16 px (rounded to 4 px steps), default 4.
config.acechat.chat.symbol_color.tooltip: Bracket colour: affects the < > symbols only; the name uses the configured name colour and the body stays white. Default white, shared by the top HUD, the T-screen replay and the bottom-left vanilla chat.
config.acechat.portrait.death_overlay.to: Death overlay: when a player dies while their chat message is on screen, cover their portrait; it lasts until that message disappears or is replaced (respawn does not restore it). Only affects others, never yourself. Range ON/OFF, default ON.
config.acechat.portrait.death_preset.too: Use the built-in preset: black square with a centred white NO SIGN, generated at runtime, filling the background frame exactly (no image file needed).
No built-in preset: only cover when a matching 1:1 square image for that player exists in the deaths folder.
config.acechat.portrait.death_max_size.t: Overlay read size: read/display size cap for images in the deaths folder, up to 1024. Range 64~1024 px, default 256.
config.acechat.portrait.death_scale.tool: Overlay scale: size of the death overlay layer. Range 20%~400%, default 100%.
config.acechat.portrait.death_offset_x.t: Overlay X offset: horizontal nudge. Range -200~200 px, default 0.
config.acechat.portrait.death_offset_y.t: Overlay Y offset: vertical nudge. Range -200~200 px, default 0.
config.acechat.portrait.open_deaths.tool: Opens config/acechat/deaths/: drop <player name>.png to set someone's death overlay image (1:1 squares only; non-square files are ignored with a log note).
screen.acechat.portrait.death_hint: Death overlay file name: <player name>.png (1:1 squares only)
config.acechat.elements.unknown_hint: Health and hunger are read from the displayed player; offline/unloaded players show Unknown. Hunger, armour and ping are only accurate for yourself — others always show Unknown.
screen.acechat.cards.select: Pick a card (click to select and apply)
screen.acechat.cards.default: Default card (used by players without their own)
screen.acechat.cards.online: Players online now (click: a card is copied from the default if missing)
screen.acechat.cards.local: Local cards (including offline players; kept between sessions)
screen.acechat.cards.functions: What to edit on this card? (each entry opens the details)
screen.acechat.cards.back_to.tooltip: Back to the card menu; every change is written to this card's file immediately.
screen.acechat.cards.open_cards.tooltip: Opens config/acechat/cards/ — one json per card, easy to back up or copy by hand.
screen.acechat.cards.new_card.tooltip: Copies the CURRENT card into a new card with the name in the box on the left; empty or duplicate names are rejected with a hint.
screen.acechat.cards.delete_card.tooltip: Deletes the selected card (the default card cannot be deleted; falls back to it).
screen.acechat.cards.cant_delete_default: The default card cannot be deleted
config.acechat.cards.auto.tooltip: Auto switch: whenever a player is on screen, their card is applied automatically; when off, the selected card stays. Range ON/OFF, default ON.
config.acechat.tab.cards.tooltip: Player cards: level 1 picks a card (default / online players / local cards), level 2 picks a function, level 3 holds the details.
screen.acechat.cards.edit.tooltip: Opens level 2 of this card; pick a function, then tweak details at level 3. Every level can go back.
screen.acechat.cards.selected: Card selected (press Edit this card to continue)
screen.acechat.cards.new_name.tooltip: Name for the new card (a player name is recommended). Then press Duplicate current card above.
screen.acechat.cards.need_name: Enter a name in New card name first
screen.acechat.cards.import_hint: Import a card: click a file below (files live in ACE_config/export/cards/; drop someone's card there and hit "Reload list")
screen.acechat.cards.import_selected.too: Import the selected json as a character card (card name = file name).
screen.acechat.cards.import_pick_first: Click a file in the list first
screen.acechat.cards.import_failed: Import failed (card name taken or not a valid card file)
screen.acechat.data.import_hint: Import the whole mod config: click a file below (files live in ACE_config/export/)
screen.acechat.data.open_config_dir.tool: Open ACE_config/ in your file manager: client.json, cards/, portraits·filters·deaths·sounds/ and the export/ folder used for import/export.
screen.acechat.data.import_selected.tool: Import the selected config file; the current client.json is backed up first, and files without a version field are refused.
screen.acechat.data.import_pick_first: Click a file in the list first
screen.acechat.cards.rename_card.tooltip: Rename the current card to the name in the box on the left; the card file is renamed too and all settings are kept. The default card cannot be renamed.
screen.acechat.cards.export_card.tooltip: Write the current card to config/acechat/export/cards/<name>.json so you can hand it to someone; nothing is copied into cards/.
screen.acechat.cards.import_card.tooltip: Read every .json in config/acechat/export/cards/ and import them as cards (card name = file name); duplicates are skipped.
screen.acechat.cards.rename_failed: Rename failed (empty name / already exists / the default card cannot be renamed)
screen.acechat.cards.export_failed: Export failed (card not readable or no write permission)
screen.acechat.cards.import_none: Nothing to import: put the other player's card json into config/acechat/export/cards/ and click again
config.acechat.portrait.skin_offset_x.to: Horizontal offset of the skin/character drawing, shared by every display mode. Range -120~120 px, default 0.
config.acechat.portrait.skin_offset_y.to: Vertical offset of the skin/character drawing, shared by every display mode. Range -120~120 px, default 0.
config.acechat.data.export_card.tooltip: Copies the selected card to _export_<card>.json inside config/acechat/cards/, handy for a per-card backup or sharing.
config.acechat.data.open_cards.tooltip: Opens config/acechat/cards/: one json per card — copy the whole folder for a full backup.
screen.acechat.data.cards_hint: Note: cards are one file each; copying config/acechat/cards/ backs them all up. Import/export above covers the global config plus the current card.
screen.acechat.data.card_export_failed: Card export failed (target file may already exist)
config.acechat.filter.tint.tooltip: Colour mask: multiplies the filter layer (white = unchanged). Combine with opacity below to tint scanlines red, the vignette blue, and so on.
config.acechat.filter.effect_color.toolt: Changes the current built-in effect's own colour (scanlines/grain/vignette/dots each keep their own), without touching its shape or strength.
config.acechat.filter.brightness.tooltip: Brightness of the filter layer itself (baked into the filter texture). Range 30%~180%, default 100%.
config.acechat.filter.contrast.tooltip: Contrast of the filter layer itself. Range 30%~200%, default 100%.
config.acechat.filter.saturation.tooltip: Saturation of the filter layer itself. Range 0%~200%, default 100%.
config.acechat.filter.hue.tooltip: Hue shift of the filter layer itself. Range -180~180 degrees, default 0.
screen.acechat.group.filter_grade: -- Filter grading (does not change effect shape) --
config.acechat.debug.timing.tooltip: When on, the HUD logs a line per second if a frame takes over 3ms (with cumulative portrait/filter bake counts) to locate frame drops. Turn it off after diagnosing.
config.acechat.portrait.reload_render.to: Clears the portrait/filter/death-overlay/graded-skin texture caches and re-reads them. Press this to force a refresh when something looks wrong, no restart needed.
screen.acechat.elements.reset_positions: Safe reset: move text back into the card
Moved %s text elements back into the card
Resets only the anchor and offsets of the text elements so they sit safely inside the card (the built-in name and vitals are switched back on). Content, colour, size, shadow and max width are kept. This differs from Reset default elements, which rebuilds the elements themselves.
config.acechat.preview.drag.tooltip: What the mouse may drag in the preview area: No dragging = view only; Card only = drag the card and resize via its bottom-right corner; Text only = move text elements and change their size; Everything = both (easiest to mis-click). Default: card only.
config.acechat.chat.visible_lines.toolti: Controls how many lines appear on screen by lowering vanilla's chat height option (vanilla full = 10), default 5. No data is deleted: the T chat screen still holds the full history and scrolls with the mouse wheel. Note this changes vanilla's own chat height setting.
config.acechat.chat.screen_lines: Max lines in chat screen (0 = unlimited)
config.acechat.chat.screen_lines.tooltip: How many lines the T chat screen shows at most (default 10). Older history stays available by scrolling the mouse wheel.
